summary.name: Inkheart
summary.one_liner: Inkheart is a self-hosted PDF library indexer and reader with a Rust backend and a Svelte single-page frontend.
use_cases: host a personal PDF library on your own server
index and browse a collection of PDF files
read PDFs in a web browser
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Inkheart as a self-hosted PDF library indexer and reader. The backend is written in Rust and the frontend is a Svelte SPA. It is listed in the awesome-selfhosted project under Document Management - E-books, where it is described as a lightweight PDF library and reader, licensed under Apache-2.0 and available as a Docker image. The GitLab page shows 323 commits, 1 branch, 14 tags, 2 releases, and a README and CHANGELOG. The page does not list detailed features beyond indexing and reading.
notable: Rust backend with Svelte single-page frontend
Listed in awesome-selfhosted under Document Management - E-books
